name: Apyrous Papyrus
body:
Price 1,000 gp; Slot none; CL 2nd; Weight —; Aura faint evocation

DESCRIPTION

Also known as a bomb scroll, this flaky sheet of parchment is both highly combustible and conducive to fire magic. When used to create a scroll with a spell that deals fire damage, the spell deals an additional 2d6 points of fire damage when the scroll is activated.

Alternatively, if the apyrous papyrus is lit with a flame, it will explode, dealing 2d6 damage in a 10-foot square. If the apyrous papyrus contains a spell with the fire descriptor when used in this way, it deals 1 additional d6 of fire damage per caster level.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 500 gp; Feats Scribe Scroll, spark, fireball
